column1: The unmasked hijacker wears a turban, a grey jacket, blue jeans and has a 9 mm Beretta clutched in his hands.
column2: 未蒙面劫機犯戴著頭巾，穿灰色外套和藍色牛仔褲，手中緊握一把 9 mm Beretta。

column1: The masked hijacker wears a ski mask, a loose green jacket with many pockets, and blue jeans. He has an Uzi machine gun in his grip.
column2: 蒙面劫機犯戴著滑雪面罩，穿著有許多口袋的寬鬆綠外套和藍色牛仔褲，手中握著 Uzi 衝鋒槍。

column1: Keith is already checking the cockpit; you're searching the passenger area.
column2: 基斯已經在檢查駕駛艙；你正在搜索客艙。

column1: You check but the lifeless body is missing all vital signs.
column2: 你檢查後確認這具沒有生命的身體沒有任何生命跡象。

column1: Be more specific about what you want to search.
column2: 請更具體說明你想搜索什麼。

column1: What do you want to search on the unmasked hijacker?
column2: 你想搜索未蒙面劫機犯的哪個部位？

column1: What do you want to search on the masked hijacker?
column2: 你想搜索蒙面劫機犯的哪個部位？

column1: Which hijacker: the masked or the unmasked one?
column2: 哪一名劫機犯：蒙面的還是未蒙面的？

column1: You find nothing in the jacket pockets of the unmasked hijacker.
column2: 你在未蒙面劫機犯的外套口袋裡什麼也沒找到。

column1: You find nothing in the jacket pockets of the masked hijacker.
column2: 你在蒙面劫機犯的外套口袋裡什麼也沒找到。

column1: You find a pair of wire clippers in the jacket pocket of the masked hijacker.
column2: 你在蒙面劫機犯的外套口袋裡找到一把剪線鉗。

column1: Looking through the shirt of the %s hijacker you find nothing.
column2: 你查看%s劫機犯的襯衫，什麼也沒找到。

column1: You check the unmasked hijacker's pockets and find what appears to be some sort of name on an ID card.
column2: 你檢查未蒙面劫機犯的口袋，在身分證卡片上找到疑似姓名的東西。

column1: You look at the name on the obviously phony ID card..."Ahmad Abad Duud."
column2: 你查看明顯是偽造身分證上的姓名……「Ahmad Abad Duud。」

column1: You put the ID back in his pocket for later identification.
column2: 你把身分證放回他的口袋，留待日後辨認。

column1: Looking through the pants of the masked hijacker you find nothing.
column2: 你查看蒙面劫機犯的褲子，什麼也沒找到。

column1: You find nothing more.
column2: 你沒有找到其他東西。

column1: You search the unmasked hijackers turban and find a piece of paper entitled: BUILDING YOUR OWN BOMB.
column2: 你搜索未蒙面劫機犯的頭巾，找到一張標題為「自己製造炸彈」的紙。

column1: You lift the mask off the hijacker and find nothing but an ugly face.
column2: 你掀開劫機犯的面罩，只看到一張醜陋的臉。

column1: You don't see a bomb here.
column2: 你在這裡看不到炸彈。

column1: What?
column2: 什麼？

column1: The timer stops. The bomb is disarmed!
column2: 計時器停止了。炸彈已解除！

column1: You don't need the disarmed bomb.
column2: 你不需要已解除的炸彈。

column1: As you take the bomb...
column2: 當你拿起炸彈時……

column1: The bomb is already disarmed.
column2: 炸彈已經解除。
